films.title: Troy
films.description: The wooden horse and the burning city — Petersen's epic made the sack the defining Trojan image for a generation.

popCulture.title: Trojan War
popCulture.description: The night the horse enters and Priam's city falls — the Sack remains the archetype of civilization ending in fire.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Book II is Aeneas' testimony of the sack — Sinon, Laocoön, and the gods withdrawing as Troy dies.
